narrative.text:
In the last 7 days, 39 transitions occurred, all timestamped on 2026-09-21, driven primarily by seeded entries from the pipeline’s synthetic registrant list. This represents a sharp acceleration from the prior week, where only 1 transition occurred on 2026-09-13, and reflects a concentrated burst of activity in the lead and marketingqualifiedlead stages, with 14 leads and 5 MQLs created in the window. The movement was not organic: 7 of the 39 transitions were seeded, including the sole opportunity created for dsmith@chewy.com (Chewy) and multiple MQL advances for contacts like djohnson@chewy.com, amit@apollohospitals.com, neha.rao@havells.com, and siriporn@ninjavan.co, all pushed via the seed phase on 2026-09-21T15:11:42.

Over the 14- and 30-day windows, the total transitions remained flat at 40, indicating that the 7-day surge was followed by no further movement — a plateau after the initial spike. The same 32 contacts accounted for all transitions across all windows, with no new stage progression beyond what was seen in the 7-day window. The bulk of organic movement (hubspot_history) occurred on 2026-09-21T15:10:07, where 32 contacts moved into subscriber, lead, or evangelist stages — including kai8karma+speaker-qhamirani@gmail.com (HighLevel) to lead and evangelist, and divya@gmail.com, rjohnson@wayfair.com, and others to subscriber — but none advanced beyond lead without seeded intervention.

Contacts with engagement that did not move stages include kai8karma+speaker-qhamirani@gmail.com (HighLevel), divya@gmail.com (Self-employed), rjohnson@wayfair.com (Wayfair), jwilson@planetfitness.com (PF), ahmad.hassan98@gmail.com (Self-employed), aiyah.abdullah@sea.com (Sea Limited Ltd), mohammed.alsayed@majidalfuttaim.com (Majid Al Futtaim), maryam.alzaabi@almarai.com (Almarai), nisha@yahoo.com (Self-employed Ltd), sureshd@axisbank.com (Axis Bank), siriporn@ninjavan.co (NV), pkulkarni@asianpaints.com (asian paints), sanjay.reddy@asianpaints.com (asian paints), yalsayed@qatarairways.com (Qatar Airways), sanjay.rao@hdfcbank.com (HDFC Bank Ltd), siripornw@ocbc.com (OCBC Ltd), neha.rao@havells.com (Havells), dgupta@persistent.com (Persistent Systems), siti@ocbc.com (OCBC), rverma82@rediffmail.com (Unknown), nehai@sunpharma.com (Sun Pharma), karan.sharma@godrejcp.com (Godrej Consumer Products), muhammad.abdullah@axiata.com (Axiata Ltd), rohann@sunpharma.com (Sun Pharma Ltd), nalfarsi@talabat.com (talabat), vikramn@darwinbox.com (Darwinbox), ahmeda@emirates.com (Emirates Group), and kai8karma+speaker-sudikorba@gmail.com (Darwinbox) — all of whom engaged but remained in subscriber, lead, or evangelist stages without further progression.

Source mix: 7 of the 40 transitions in the 14- and 30-day windows were seeded by this pipeline, not organic CRM history, and must not be mistaken for genuine engagement-driven movement.
